title: Bulk line total
requirement: bulkLineTotal: line total, 5% off from qty 10, rounded once HALF_UP, invalid lines rejected.
task: Add a method `public BigDecimal bulkLineTotal(BigDecimal unitPrice, int qty)` to DiscountService. It returns unitPrice * qty. If qty is 10 or more, a 5% discount applies to the line total. Round only the final line total, once, to 2 decimals using HALF_UP (do not round per unit). A null or negative unitPrice or qty <= 0 throws IllegalArgumentException.
known_defect: discounted unit price rounded per unit (0.99 x 10 -> 9.40 instead of 9.41)
rationale: Where the rounding happens changes the cents.
